map.增值税=不含税造价×增值税率；城建税=增值税×城建税率（市区7%/县城5%/其他: VAT = tax-exclusive cost times VAT rate; urban tax = VAT times urban rate (city 7% / county 5% / other 1%); education surcharge = VAT times 3%; local education surcharge = VAT times 2%; total surcharge = sum of the three; tax-inclusive cost = tax-exclusive cost + VAT; total with surcharge = tax-inclusive cost + surcharge; combined tax rate = VAT rate + VAT rate times (urban+education+local)/100.

map.按工程所在地：市区 7%、县城/镇 5%、其他 1%；教育费附加统一 3%、地方: By project location: city 7%, county/town 5%, other 1%; education surcharge uniformly 3%, local education surcharge 2% in most regions (subject to local rules); the combined tax rate floats with the urban tax rate.
map.综合税费率 10.08% 怎么来的？: Where does the 10.08% combined tax rate come from?
map.增值税率 9% 本身，附加税费以增值税为基数再征 (7+3+2)%=12%，故: The VAT rate of 9% itself, plus surtaxes levied on VAT at (7+3+2)%=12%, so 9% times (1+12%)=10.08%; this is the combined tax burden relative to the tax-exclusive cost.
